KEY FACTS

The Bahamas tourism board describes Andros as a network of sandy flats, mangrove cays, creeks and channels supporting bonefish, permit and tarpon. Its account emphasizes spotting fish and following guide direction.

The Bahamas — Fly fishing on Andros ↗

Bonefish is recorded in the fishery source.

Fishery source for Andros, The Bahamas ↗
SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

The source does not establish a complete bonefish calendar or specific tide window for every Andros area. Keep arrival airport, lodge location and fishing area aligned, and have the guide explain how the intended dates affect daily access and presentation.

Confirm the actual island base

Andros is not one interchangeable marina. Put the lodge or guide’s meeting location and transfer arrangement into the itinerary before buying flights. Ask whether fishing begins from that base or requires an additional transfer. Include a practical arrival buffer rather than treating the first hour after landing as guaranteed fishing time.

Prepare to see and present

A well-organized practice session can be more useful than extra flies. Ask which casting distances and conditions are realistic for the outing and practice with the outfit you intend to use. Confirm the fly selection locally. Separate a bonefish setup from any specialist permit or tarpon additions rather than assuming one outfit meets every possible encounter.

Choose footwear from the planned access

A skiff-only day and guided wading across a particular substrate require different footwear decisions. Ask for the operator’s exact recommendation and whether rental options exist. Reduce loose gear around the casting position. Use a small accessible bag for sun coverage, rain protection and spare leaders, with a separate dry compartment for travel essentials.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Bahamas

Anglers aged 12 and older need a personal licence for flats fishing. A foreign-owned boat also needs a sport fishing permit; the boat permit does not replace the flats licence.

  • Day of issueVisitor flats daily
  • 1 weekVisitor flats weekly
  • 1 monthVisitor flats monthly
  • 1 yearVisitor flats annual
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Foreign-owned vessel sport fishing permit ↗
    Operators of foreign-owned vessels used for sport fishing. Arrange the vessel permit through Bahamas Customs or Marine Resources.

Rules for this water

  • A certified guide is required when two or more anglers fish the flats from a vessel.
  • Do not use a speargun or sell fish caught on the flats.

Full Bahamas licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
